# wellgraph

> Read-only MCP server over a knowledge graph of Norwegian continental shelf wellbores:
> SODIR backbone (wellbores, formation tops, hole sections) plus drilling events
> (lost circulation, kicks, stuck pipe, tight hole, instability) extracted from public
> end-of-well reports, each with a page-level citation.

To use it, connect an MCP client to the server and call `describe_graph` first. The
server is self-describing. Hosted endpoint (temporary): https://wellgraph.happystone-2f8f8670.norwayeast.azurecontainerapps.io/mcp . Local run:
`PYTHONPATH=src uv run python -m wellgraph.mcp_server` (stdio) or add `--http --port 7860`
and connect to `http://localhost:7860/mcp`.

## Docs

- [README](README.md): what it is, how to connect, the six tools
- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): how an agent should query the graph or work on the code
- [Plan](docs/PLAN.md): goals, design decisions, data findings, open questions
- [Sample reports](samples/README.md): four report JSONs and their structure

## Tools

- describe_graph: coverage, units, schema, example questions
- find_wells: wellbores by block, field, operator, formation, type, distance
- get_well_summary: one wellbore's header, formation tops, hole sections, events, reports
- query_events: events across wells by type, formation, hole size, distance, mud weight
- offset_well_analysis: aggregated events and lessons around a wellbore or location
- get_evidence: verbatim quote, report and page for one event

## Data

- Reports: Zenodo record 24320092, DOI 10.5281/zenodo.24320092, CC BY 4.0, ConocoPhillips / Diskos
- Backbone: SODIR FactPages, NLOD 2.0
